title: Migrate Doc. Exchange and OCR service callers off Http Web Request Mgt.
summary: Document Exchange and OCR service codeunits migrate from DotNet Http Web Request Mgt to native HttpClient, removing DotNet dependencies while maintaining backward-compatible public signatures.
key_points: Native HttpClient replaces DotNet HttpWebRequest in token requests, service requests, and XML parsing
SecretText and [NonDebuggable] attributes protect credentials and authorization headers
DotNet XmlDocument replaced with native XmlDocument and XML DOM Management overloads
Session cookie handling converted from DotNet Cookie to native Cookie type with explicit re-authentication logic
Base64 encoding for embedded attachments replaces DotNet File and Convert classes
quote: It follows #10755 (merged) and #12254 (draft) and uses the same patterns.
